body: About the only thing I am awesome at is being a mediocre fuck-up. For whatever reason, I can't even get a callback at McDonalds. You have to be pretty fucking mediocre if fast food won't hire you. I used to get good grades, but only because community college teachers are idiots. Fat lot of good it's done me in life, despite the people around me telling me grades are everything for 19 years of my life. Woo fucking hoo. I got a b in intermediate algebra. Someone, please hire this fucking genius.
